description:
Big Jay Oakerson, Luis J. Gomez, and Steve Rannazzisi are comedians and hosts of the "Legion of Skanks" podcast. Big Jay and Luis also co-host the "Story Warz" podcast. Big Jay co-hosts "The Bonfire" on SiriusXM, while Luis co-hosts "Real Ass Podcast" and "The Regz." Steve co-hosts "What's the Odds." All three are currently on tour.
